c: Charm is one of the player stats in Vampire Survivors. It buffs the spawn quantity of enemies.
Charm increases the quantity of enemies in each wave by a flat amount; the amount of which corresponds to the current value of the player's Charm stat.
It is added last after other bonuses that affect enemy spawn quantity, such as
. This results in waves always spawning a fixed value of additional enemies which may cause the 500 maximum enemy quantity limit to be reached and constantly filled.
The Charm PowerUp increases the quantity of enemies spawned by 20 per rank, with a maximum rank of 5. At rank 5, it increases enemy quantity by 100. It initially costs
